**Marigold Pavilion** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia.

This location was once a small park, consisting of the central pavilion and a lake, acting as an attraction for tourists and hikers. [1] 

“To the east of Point Pleasant, atop a rugged hillside, is an old wooden structure, along with an irradiated lake, which once beckoned tourists and hikers. Check the lake for a sunken safe to open.”— Atlas of Appalachia

A wooden structure on the mountainside east of Point Pleasant. A large billboard overlooks a small pond to the south where a Canoe is tied up. Right behind the pond is a small campsite located in front of the pavilion itself. A Cooking Station is located here, next to a table and a chair.

There is a Weapons Workbench inside the pavilion on the lower floor. The upstairs can be accessed via a broken section of the ceiling which forms a makeshift ramp upwards. There are two Mattresses upstairs, as well as some toys and a Banjo. Due east of the cabin, following a small trail, there is a recent gravesite with flowers and a Radbear.

This location has the potential of spawning a random encounter between two fighting groups of NPCs.

- Potential Vault-Tec Bobblehead - On the second floor, between two Mattresses, sitting on a floorboard sticking up.
- Potential Magazine - On the second floor, to the left of the red dirty Bed.

Marigold Pavilion appears in *Fallout 76*.
